parentOf: Credential Transaction State Machine while ACTIVE

UNINITIALIZED.allowedDiskFiles: No completed marker, metadata, journal or formal vault. A stale temporary file is never authority.
UNINITIALIZED.crashRecovery: Repeat detection. No durable identity is claimed before lifecycle intent.

LEGACY_AUTHORITY_DETECTED.allowedDiskFiles: Supported WP3 credentials.safe.json only; WP4 metadata, sealed journal and completed marker absent.
LEGACY_AUTHORITY_DETECTED.vaultState: Read-only WP3 source authority; every reference must decrypt strictly.
LEGACY_AUTHORITY_DETECTED.journalState: Absent until migration intent is durable.
LEGACY_AUTHORITY_DETECTED.crashRecovery: Preserve WP3 vault byte-for-byte, then resume the same migration or fail closed.

BOOTSTRAP_PREPARING.allowedDiskFiles: Durable lifecycle intent; formal empty vault may be absent or match the intent digest.
BOOTSTRAP_PREPARING.journalState: Absent or the exact deterministic genesis journal bound by the intent.
BOOTSTRAP_PREPARING.crashRecovery: Resume the same operationId, vaultEpoch, journalId and genesisEventId.

BOOTSTRAP_COMMITTING.allowedDiskFiles: Lifecycle intent, exact empty vault, exact genesis journal, metadata when projected, and completed marker only at final boundary.
BOOTSTRAP_COMMITTING.crashRecovery: Complete the same deterministic genesis; never create a second epoch or event.

MIGRATION_PREPARING.allowedDiskFiles: Original WP3 vault plus durable migration intent. WP4 files may only match the same intent.
MIGRATION_PREPARING.vaultState: Original encrypted WP3 image remains authoritative and unchanged.
MIGRATION_PREPARING.journalState: Absent or exact MIGRATION_GENESIS journal bound to source and target digests.
MIGRATION_PREPARING.crashRecovery: Resume the same migrationId and operationId; decrypt failure preserves the original vault and fails closed.

MIGRATION_COMMITTING.allowedDiskFiles: Original vault, migration intent, exact MIGRATION_GENESIS journal, projected metadata, and completed marker at the final boundary.
MIGRATION_COMMITTING.vaultState: Reference set and ciphertext digest equal the strictly validated WP3 snapshot.
MIGRATION_COMMITTING.journalState: One MIGRATION_GENESIS event records source schema, migrationId and source/target vault digests.
MIGRATION_COMMITTING.crashRecovery: Complete the same migration exactly once or fail closed while preserving the WP3 vault.

ACTIVE.allowedDiskFiles: Formal vault, sealed authority journal, metadata head projection and lifecycle completed marker; no foreign intent.
ACTIVE.vaultState: Digest and reference count equal the journal authority head.
ACTIVE.journalState: Valid sealed continuous authority chain and durable requestId history.
ACTIVE.metadataState: Valid recoverable projection of the authority head.
ACTIVE.fd5Allowed: Only with no active owner transaction and complete strict decryption.
ACTIVE.fd6Allowed: Only for the owner session established by the accepted FD5 frame.
ACTIVE.crashRecovery: Run transaction sub-state recovery, strict authority projection verification and owner-session admission.

OWNER_EXIT_RECOVERY.allowedDiskFiles: Same durable ACTIVE authority files; no new lifecycle authority is created.
OWNER_EXIT_RECOVERY.vaultState: Before or after boundary allowed only when explained by the active owner transaction.
OWNER_EXIT_RECOVERY.journalState: Owner-bound transaction is recovered to COMMITTED, ROLLED_BACK or FAILED.
OWNER_EXIT_RECOVERY.metadataState: Completed to the selected durable terminal boundary.
OWNER_EXIT_RECOVERY.crashRecovery: Finish rollback/commit recovery; unknown state becomes UNAVAILABLE.

UNAVAILABLE.allowedDiskFiles: Preserved for diagnosis; no file is rewritten merely to make startup continue.
UNAVAILABLE.vaultState: Untrusted until a future verified recovery succeeds.
UNAVAILABLE.journalState: Missing, damaged, ambiguous or inconsistent history remains fail-closed evidence.
UNAVAILABLE.crashRecovery: No automatic transition. Stable reasonCode is reported and restart loops are forbidden.
